status: Prespecified paid-job-learning study; parameters freeze before independent confirmation.
currency: USD, pre-tax; transaction-tax pass-through and corporate-income-tax schedules excluded

human_reference.basis: Published GSA role rates multiplied by explicit assumed multidisciplinary effort; not a received quote or proof of human-only methods.

operations.collection_timing: collection_probability is observed payment authorization at delivery. Authorized amounts settle after collection_lag months; no later counterparty default is modeled. Failed authorization is known at delivery and incurs all work costs. Only cleared cash may fund spending.
operations.fixed_automation_scope: Monthly control and business-automation fees cover deterministic monitoring, billing/listings and orchestration subscriptions, not unmetered frontier-model calls.

market.observed_choice: Only our purchase/nonpurchase; other choices are analyst-only latent labels.
market.price_game: Seller posts a bounded-grid price; buyers best respond among our package, human service, retain current method and decline. Outside-provider prices are exogenous in primary; no Nash claim.

scope.sampling_unit: A distinct buyer/deployment or genuinely new integration/schema contract producing the full executable decision-engine package. Repeated allocation answers or changing cost/capacity/eligibility inputs inside a sold engine are included and create no additional full-package sale.
scope.ordinary_case_specific_learning_descript: Observed approved deliveries may leave narrow setup/context metadata. This reduces a small fraction of later reconstruction activity but never increases mechanical or semantic correctness; it does not create a broad admitted component or free transfer.

policy.exploration: None in primary price controller; Bayesian learning uses endogenous purchased/nonpurchased offers. Optional exploration is a separate ablation.
policy.objective: Approximate posterior expected terminal pre-tax cash net of seed; receding-horizon one-campaign lookahead, not globally optimal POMDP. Cash/reserve and conservative next-period solvency constraints are separate eligibility constraints.
policy.risk_constraint: Deterministic protection of known liabilities, reserve-month fixed obligations and cash headroom; no claim of a general probabilistic cash-shortfall guarantee. Monte Carlo insolvency is reported separately.

nonclaims: No novel optimization algorithm is claimed.
Synthetic mechanism correctness does not calibrate frontier model accuracy.
No real buyers, provider model execution, transactions or ENS authentication are represented as observed.
No prescribed price discount or minimum number of investments defines success.
Missing retained assets do not remove the frontier baseline's ability to reconstruct the same compiler and checker.
Candidate, validated artifact, admitted positive expected Alpha and realized net value are distinct.
Moving Beta schedules and modeled net-Alpha estimates are assumptions, not observed autonomous invention or a permanent moat.
Shared versus private network policies have identical agent counts and aggregate provider quotas.

network.scope: Authenticated direct-label *.agent.agi.eth members; simulated identity checks only. All shareable admitted Alpha is discoverable and optionally usable by every member subject to scope, versions, prerequisites, freshness and revocation. No club authority changes.
network.initial_beta_description: Competent current frontier models, public optimization tools and every already available recipient-compatible retained or equivalent capability; no absence-of-file incapability assumption.
network.effect_interpretation: Named reconstructible activities are avoided only after supported admission and successful recipient adaptation. Fractions expose uncertain transfer of component activity/reliability into complete project work; they are not a generic expert-use bonus.

paid_job_learning.candidate_trigger: Observable validated delivery, irrespective of latent material correctness or future collections. Source rights and portability are simulated and may fail.
paid_job_learning.scope_boundary: One source-job-bound schema capsule. No global capability emerges from one bespoke job. Original installed-engine uses remain included and are never new full-package sales.
paid_job_learning.local_reuse_boundary: The originator retains ordinary useful source artifacts in its competent Beta. Paid Alpha retention pays only incremental sanitized portability/generalization and new evidence.
